Q907.reason: An instruction that the jury 'could infer' intent is a permissive inference. It leaves the jury free to reject it and does not shift the burden of proof.

Q993.reason: FRCP 38(b) lets a party demand a jury in the pleading itself or within 14 days after the last pleading directed to the issue, so including the demand in the complaint secures the right.
